title: imbalanced_synth
summary: A code repository reproducing an SDV blog post experiment on whether synthetic oversampling helps imbalanced classification tasks, using custom pipeline samplers with proper cross-validation to avoid leakage. It directly runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer from sdv.single_table, built on an sdv.metadata.Metadata schema, to generate synthetic minority-class data for the pipelines.
